newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks tumble, end more than two pct lower.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks tumble, end more than two pct lower.

text.p: Tokyo stocks stumbled late in Wednesday afternoon trade to end more than two percent lower, rattled by comments by the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) deputy governor that the central bank is considering the right timing to raise the official discount rate, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average finished 490.85 points or 2.41 percent lower at 19,841.98, the lowest close since May 9, when the benchmark ended at 19,802.78.
June Nikkei futures finished at 19,820, down 520 points.

In late afternoon, BOJ Deputy Governor Toshihiko Fukui was quoted by an executive of a labour group as saying the central bank is considering the right timing to raise the official discount rate but it does not want to make a hasty decision.
